name: Joseph Cameron
bio:
With more than a decade of personal recovery and extensive experience in behavioral health business development, Joey has dedicated his career to expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based treatment for individuals and families affected by mental health and substance use disorders.
In 2020, Joey founded Quadrant Health Group with a vision of creating a boutique behavioral healthcare experience rooted in clinical excellence, compassion, and long-term recovery. What began with a single luxury treatment center in Laguna Beach has grown into a rapidly expanding, multi-state behavioral health organization serving communities across the country.
Under Joey's leadership, Quadrant Health Group has developed a network of inpatient, outpatient, and specialty behavioral health programs while remaining committed to raising the standard of care. His strategic vision, entrepreneurial drive, and unwavering belief in recovery continue to guide the organization's growth and its mission of transforming lives through exceptional treatment and compassionate care.

name: Louis Iacona
bio:
Louis Iacona plays an integral role in driving the organization's growth, brand strategy, and community outreach initiatives. With more than a decade of personal recovery and extensive experience in marketing and business development, Louis combines professional expertise with a deeply personal commitment to helping individuals and families affected by substance use and mental health disorders.
As a certified interventionist, Louis has dedicated his career to connecting people with life-changing treatment and resources during some of the most difficult moments in their lives. His unique perspective, shaped by both lived experience and years of industry leadership, allows him to build meaningful relationships while advocating for accessible, high-quality behavioral healthcare.
Guided by a passion for service, Louis remains actively involved in supporting individuals and families seeking recovery. His leadership continues to help shape Quadrant Health Group's mission of delivering compassionate, evidence-based care while expanding access to treatment for communities across the country.

name: Nicholas Petrillo
bio:
Nicholas Petrillo serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Quadrant Health Group, where he is committed to expanding access to high-quality behavioral healthcare while fostering a culture centered on compassion, clinical excellence, and long-term recovery.
With extensive experience in behavioral healthcare operations, admissions, marketing, and organizational development, Nicholas has dedicated his career to helping treatment providers better serve individuals and families seeking care. His leadership has focused on building systems that make it easier for people to access treatment, receive personalized support, and continue their recovery journey with confidence.
Since co-founding Quadrant Health Group, Nicholas has led the organization's growth across multiple states while ensuring that quality of care remains at the center of every decision. He has helped develop an integrated network of behavioral health services that includes detoxification, residential treatment, outpatient care, and supportive recovery resources, allowing clients to receive seamless care throughout every stage of healing.
Nicholas believes that lasting recovery begins with treating every individual with dignity, respect, and compassion. He is passionate about creating environments where clients feel safe, supported, and empowered to achieve meaningful, lasting change. Under his leadership, Quadrant Health Group continues to invest in experienced clinicians, innovative treatment programs, and a patient-first approach that prioritizes individualized care.
As CEO, Nicholas remains focused on expanding access to evidence-based behavioral healthcare, strengthening clinical programs, and ensuring that every person who walks through Quadrant Health Group's doors receives the support they need to build a healthier future.

name: Michael Zornberg
bio:
Michael Zornberg serves as Chief Operating Officer of Quadrant Health Group, bringing extensive expertise in behavioral healthcare operations, regulatory compliance, and multi-state facility development. Since entering the behavioral health industry in 2018, Michael has played a pivotal role in the successful development, licensing, and operational oversight of more than 100 treatment facilities across the United States. His expertise includes state and federal regulatory compliance, Joint Commission accreditation, payer requirements, and complex healthcare transactions, helping organizations achieve operational excellence while maintaining the highest standards of patient care and safety.
Before transitioning into behavioral healthcare, Michael worked in strategic partnerships with the National Football League, where he developed a strong foundation in business operations, organizational growth, and relationship management. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration and Business Law and has earned recognition as a trusted expert in healthcare compliance, frequently serving as an expert witness in legal proceedings involving behavioral health regulations and operational standards.
As Chief Operating Officer, Michael oversees the operational strategy and performance of Quadrant Health Group's growing network of behavioral healthcare facilities. His leadership is centered on building scalable, compliant systems that support clinical excellence, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth. Guided by a commitment to accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement, he is dedicated to advancing the organization's mission of delivering exceptional behavioral healthcare to the communities it serves.

name: Sal Rabie
bio:
Sal Rabie serves as the Chief Financial Officer for Quadrant Health Group, bringing more than 15 years of accounting, financial management, and strategic leadership experience. He earned his Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Long Island University, C.W. Post, and is a licensed Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
Prior to joining Quadrant Health Group, Sal spent a decade with a boutique accounting firm on Long Island, where he specialized in small business taxation and financial consulting. He later founded, owned, and successfully operated his own accounting firm for five years, leading a team of accounting professionals while providing comprehensive financial services to businesses across a variety of industries.
Throughout his career, Sal has developed extensive expertise in financial reporting, bookkeeping, payroll, tax planning and preparation, internal controls, and regulatory compliance. His experience includes preparing GAAP-compliant financial statements, serving on audit teams for both for-profit and nonprofit organizations, acting as an internal audit resource for companies requiring reviewed or audited financial statements, and representing businesses and individuals during IRS, state tax department, and Department of Labor audits. He has also served as a fractional Chief Financial Officer for numerous organizations, helping guide financial strategy, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth.
As Chief Financial Officer, Sal oversees Quadrant Health Group's financial operations, ensuring fiscal responsibility while supporting the organization's continued growth and commitment to delivering high-quality behavioral healthcare.

name: Colin McBride
bio:
As Vice President of Revenue & Billing, Colin McBride provides executive oversight and leadership to Quadrant Billing Solutions (QBS)—Quadrant Health Group’s in-house billing company. Colin led the development of QBS from the ground up, building it to meet the complex demands of behavioral health providers. Though QBS operates under the Quadrant Health Group umbrella, it functions independently with its own systems, leadership, and results-driven infrastructure. QBS remains Colin’s primary focus; however, he also plays a key strategic role across Quadrant Health Group, supporting revenue operations through clinical quality oversight, and admissions strategy across the organization’s growing network of facilities. With over a decade of experience in behavioral health, Colin’s background in direct care and facility leadership gives him a deep understanding of the challenges providers face—insights that now inform his leadership across Quadrant Health Group. Colin’s passion lies in developing innovative solutions that bridge clinical care with financial strategy, improving both patient
outcomes and organizational performance.

name: Dr. Pamela Tambini
bio:
Dr. Pamela Tambini is a board-certified physician in Internal Medicine and Addiction Medicine, entrepreneur, and healthcare executive dedicated to advancing evidence-based treatment for individuals with substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders. She is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of The Sober Connection, a physician-led medical services organization that partners with behavioral healthcare facilities nationwide to provide comprehensive medical leadership, provider staffing, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance solutions.
With extensive experience across the continuum of addiction treatment—including medical detoxification, residential treatment, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, and outpatient care—Dr. Tambini has developed scalable clinical programs that improve patient outcomes while helping organizations maintain regulatory excellence and operational efficiency. Her expertise includes addiction medicine, psychopharmacology, withdrawal management, medical stabilization, utilization review, physician leadership, and multi-state healthcare operations.
Prior to founding The Sober Connection, Dr. Tambini served as a hospitalist within the Veterans Health Administration, where she managed medically complex patients and collaborated with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality inpatient care. Her clinical expertise, combined with her operational leadership, provides a unique perspective on integrating medical excellence with sustainable healthcare systems.
Under Dr. Tambini's leadership, The Sober Connection has grown into a multi-state organization supporting behavioral healthcare facilities through physician staffing, medical directorships, quality improvement initiatives, provider education, credentialing, policy development, and clinical oversight. She is recognized for building high-performing medical teams, implementing standardized clinical processes, and helping treatment centers navigate accreditation, licensing, and payer requirements.
Dr. Tambini is passionate about raising the standard of addiction medicine by combining compassionate patient care with innovative operational strategies. Her leadership philosophy emphasizes clinical integrity, accountability, and collaboration, with a focus on creating systems that support both providers and the patients they serve.
She remains actively involved in medical education, physician mentorship, and the ongoing advancement of best practices in behavioral healthcare while continuing to care for patients and advise organizations on clinical program development, healthcare operations, and quality improvement initiatives.

name: Catherine Alpaugh
bio:
Catherine joined the Quadrant Health Group’s team as Executive Vice President bringing over a decade of industry experience and a proven track record of leadership in multisite organizations. Throughout her career, she has held key roles including Director of Admissions, where she successfully oversaw placement operations across multiple locations and was instrumental in driving growth, operational efficiency and expanding market presence.
She holds a Bachelor's degree in Marketing and a Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, combining strategic business insights with deep knowledge of healthcare operations. Her leadership is defined by a commitment to excellence, data-driven decision-making, and building high-performing teams that deliver measurable results.

name: Jessica Dalton
bio:
serves as Executive Vice President of Operations for Quadrant Health Group, bringing extensive leadership experience in behavioral healthcare operations, compliance, and organizational development. Throughout her career, she has overseen operations across multiple behavioral health and substance use treatment facilities, leading initiatives that strengthen operational performance, enhance regulatory compliance, and improve the overall quality of patient care.
With a deep understanding of healthcare operations, Jessica has successfully implemented standardized policies, optimized organizational processes, and fostered collaboration across multidisciplinary teams to support sustainable growth and clinical excellence. Her strategic approach to leadership has helped organizations maintain high standards while creating efficient, patient-centered systems of care.
Jessica earned her bachelor's degree from Indiana University of Pennsylvania and is a National Certified Peer Recovery Support Specialist (NCPRSS). She is recognized for her collaborative leadership style, commitment to professional development, and passion for empowering teams to achieve operational excellence. As Executive Vice President of Operations, she is dedicated to advancing Quadrant Health Group's mission by building high-performing teams and ensuring exceptional care across the organization's growing network of behavioral health facilities.

name: Riley Monahan
bio: Riley Monahan joins Quadrant Health Group with over a decade of experience in behavioral health, spanning clinical practice and organizational leadership. Prior to Quadrant, Riley worked in clinical and administrative roles at a large, multi-location Arizona-based behavioral health agency while working in a private practice setting serving high performers and entrepreneurs. His clinical background includes trauma-focused therapy, EMDR, and specialized intensives, along with corporate retreat facilitation and executive mediation. We're excited to have him on the team.

name: Chelsea Stelmach
bio: Chelsea Stelmach is the Director of Marketing at Quadrant Health Group, where she leads the organization's branding, digital marketing, communications, and public relations initiatives. With more than a decade of experience in behavioral healthcare marketing, she is passionate about building trusted brands, sharing meaningful stories, and connecting individuals and families with quality mental health and addiction treatment resources. Chelsea combines creative strategy with a patient-first approach to ensure every communication reflects the compassion, integrity, and excellence that define Quadrant Health Group.

name: Stephanie Hakim
bio:
Stephanie Hakim serves as the Director of Compliance for Quadrant Health Group, where she leads the organization's compliance, regulatory, and quality assurance initiatives across its behavioral healthcare programs. She is committed to fostering a culture of integrity, accountability, and operational excellence by ensuring compliance is seamlessly integrated into every aspect of the organization.
What distinguishes Stephanie's approach to compliance is her comprehensive understanding of treatment center operations. Throughout her career, she has held leadership roles in executive operations, admissions, information technology, medication management, and clinical services as a Certified Drug and Alcohol Counselor (CADCII). This diverse experience provides her with a unique perspective on how regulatory requirements impact every stage of the patient experience—from the first point of contact through discharge planning, quality improvement, and organizational performance.
Stephanie leads the development and implementation of compliance programs, regulatory initiatives, policy development, internal auditing, corrective action planning, and accreditation readiness. She works collaboratively with state regulatory agencies and The Joint Commission to ensure Quadrant Health Group consistently meets and exceeds regulatory standards while advancing quality improvement, mitigating organizational risk, and promoting the delivery of safe, ethical, and high-quality care.
Beyond regulatory oversight, Stephanie is passionate about building sustainable systems that empower organizations to thrive. She believes compliance is more than meeting standards—it is the foundation of exceptional patient care, operational excellence, and organizational integrity. By fostering collaboration across clinical, operational, medical, and executive teams, she helps translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, sustainable processes that strengthen both compliance and organizational performance.
Stephanie is recognized for her strategic leadership, collaborative approach, and ability to bridge the gap between regulations and day-to-day operations. Her commitment to excellence continues to support Quadrant Health Group's mission of delivering compassionate, high-quality behavioral healthcare while maintaining the highest standards of compliance and accountability.

name: Marc North
bio:
Marc North has spent more than a decade serving the recovery community, beginning his career as a Certified Peer Recovery Specialist (CPRS) in nonprofit organizations. His frontline experience supporting individuals with substance use disorders built a strong foundation in recovery, leadership, and patient-centered care.
Marc advanced into leadership roles at Wellness Recovery Center of New Jersey, serving first as Director of Operations and later as Executive Director, where he led multidisciplinary teams, oversaw daily operations, and drove strategic initiatives that strengthened both organizational performance and patient care.
Today, Marc serves as Procurement Manager for Quadrant Health Group, where he oversees strategic sourcing, vendor partnerships, and purchasing operations across a multi-state network of behavioral healthcare facilities. His unique blend of recovery, operational, and executive leadership experience enables him to build efficient systems that strengthen organizational performance while supporting exceptional patient care.

name: Danielle Gorman
bio:
Danielle Gorman is the Executive Coordinator at Quadrant Health Group. Danielle brings extensive leadership experience and a hands-on approach to every aspect of the organization. Her role encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, providing support wherever it is needed to help teams operate efficiently and successfully.
Danielle is passionate about building strong teams, creating organized systems, and helping others succeed. She takes great pride in being part of a company dedicated to changing lives by guiding individuals on their journey to recovery.

name: Anom Grant
bio:
As an IT Director with over a decade of experience, I bring a distinctive approach to technology leadership. My background in Psychology isn't just a detail; it's the very foundation of my career transition into IT. I firmly believe that technology should empower, not complicate, the human experience at work. This unique perspective drives me to transform tech landscapes, focusing on efficiency and innovation by ensuring IT initiatives truly align with business goals and build robust, scalable systems that enhance both organizational growth and overall user well-being.
My core strengths lie in dynamic team leadership, strategic project management, and comprehensive system optimizations. I consistently apply these skills to refine our technological infrastructure and streamline workflows. This ensures our IT operations are not only resilient and reliable but also directly contribute to achieving the organization's strategic objectives, making technology a true enabler. Moving forward, I'm passionate about leveraging my expertise to deepen organizational efficiency in ways that genuinely uplift both our internal teams and our valued clients. My aim is to implement tech solutions that optimize performance while simultaneously fostering a seamless, intuitive, and highly productive experience for everyone. I'm always eager to connect with fellow leaders to explore how thoughtful IT strategy can spark innovation and significantly boost user satisfaction.

name: Diana Guzman
bio:
Diana Guzman serves as Human Resources Manager at Quadrant Health Group, where she is dedicated to fostering a workplace culture built on trust, communication, and employee engagement. She believes that people are the heart of every organization and that meaningful relationships are the foundation of a strong and successful team.
Passionate about creating a positive employee experience, Diana views communication as one of the most important aspects of human resources—not only ensuring information is shared clearly, but also making certain employees feel heard, supported, and valued. She strives to recognize each individual's contributions, celebrate achievements, and maintain an approachable presence where team members feel comfortable seeking guidance and support.
Diana is committed to helping cultivate an environment where employees feel connected, appreciated, and empowered to thrive. She believes that when people feel recognized and supported, they are better equipped to grow professionally, collaborate effectively, and make a meaningful impact on the individuals and communities Quadrant Health Group serves.

name: Armanee Cross
bio:
Armanee Cross, MBA serves as an HR Assistant/Coordinator at Quadrant Health Group, where she is dedicated to creating a positive employee experience and supporting team members throughout every stage of their career journey. She works closely with leadership and employees across recruitment, onboarding, HR operations, and day-to-day employee support to help foster an engaging and collaborative workplace.
Armanee holds a Master of Business Administration with a concentration in Human Resources Management and is passionate about building strong relationships, improving processes, and helping employees feel valued and supported. She believes that great workplaces are built by investing in great people and is committed to contributing to a culture where individuals and teams can thrive.

name: Kevin Bocanegra
bio:
Kevin Bocanegra is a Human Resources/Payroll Specialist at Quadrant Health Group, where he is dedicated to ensuring employees receive accurate, timely payroll while providing dependable support across payroll and human resources functions. As a U.S. Marine Corps veteran, Kevin brings the values of integrity, accountability, and service to every aspect of his work.
Kevin believes payroll is about more than processing numbers—it is about supporting the people behind them. He takes pride in managing payroll operations, assisting with payroll tax compliance, and maintaining the accuracy and reliability that employees and leadership depend on. Through clear communication, attention to detail, and a commitment to excellence, he strives to create a positive experience for every employee.
Known for his professionalism and dependable approach, Kevin is committed to solving challenges, building trust, and contributing to a workplace where employees feel respected, supported, and valued. His mission is to help ensure every team member has the confidence that their contributions are recognized through accurate and efficient payroll services.

name: Maria Gonzalez
bio:
Maria Gonzalez serves as the Talent Acquisition & Onboarding Coordinator at Quadrant Health Group, where she is passionate about connecting talented professionals with meaningful career opportunities while creating a positive and welcoming hiring experience from the very first conversation.
Working closely with hiring managers and candidates, Maria supports the full recruitment and onboarding process, helping attract exceptional talent and ensure new team members feel informed, supported, and prepared for success. She values building lasting relationships, fostering open communication, and matching individuals with opportunities where they can grow professionally while making a meaningful impact.
Maria is proud to support Quadrant Health Group's mission by helping recruit and retain compassionate, dedicated professionals who are committed to providing outstanding behavioral healthcare to the individuals and communities they serve.

name: Emmanuel Lacruz
bio:
Emmanuel Lacruz serves as an HR Talent Acquisition Recruiter, where he is passionate about connecting talented healthcare professionals with opportunities to grow, make a meaningful impact, and build rewarding careers. He works closely with candidates and hiring managers to create a seamless, transparent, and positive recruitment experience from the initial conversation through the onboarding process.
Emmanuel believes that every great organization is built on exceptional people. He is committed to identifying individuals who not only possess the skills and experience needed for success but also share a dedication to delivering compassionate, high-quality care. Known for his approachable nature and strong communication skills, he takes pride in building lasting relationships while helping candidates find positions where they can thrive professionally.
With experience recruiting nurses, therapists, behavioral health professionals, and administrative staff, Emmanuel is dedicated to supporting Quadrant Health Group's mission by attracting outstanding talent and fostering a workplace culture where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.

name: Erika Sirianos
bio:
With over 20 years of progressive leadership experience, Erika Sirianos is a seasoned Human Resources and Payroll Director with a dynamic background spanning both the nonprofit and corporate sectors. Her expertise lies in aligning people strategies with organizational goals, ensuring compliance, and fostering inclusive workplace cultures that drive performance and engagement.
Throughout her career, Erika has led HR and payroll operations in diverse environments, including behavioral health and substance abuse treatment organizations as well as educational institutions. Her hands-on experience navigating complex regulatory frameworks, managing multi-state payroll systems, and implementing HR best practices uniquely positions her to support mission-driven and growth-oriented organizations alike.
Known for her collaborative approach and strong ethical compass, Erika has a proven track record in talent management, benefits administration, policy development, and organizational change. She is especially passionate about shaping people and culture strategies that cultivate belonging, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Erika holds a deep commitment to employee well-being and organizational integrity, making her a trusted advisor to leadership teams and a valued partner to staff at all levels.

name: Ben Kolb
bio:
Ben Kolb has been in long-term recovery since August 2011\. His personal journey through addiction and into sobriety gives him a deep, authentic understanding of the challenges individuals and families face.
Since 2016, Ben has dedicated his career to the addiction treatment field, specializing in building strong strategic relationships with hospitals, interventionists, therapists, and community partners across the country. In 2022, he co-founded Dallas Detox Center, helping to create a compassionate, clinically driven detox and treatment program that puts clients’ long-term success first.
Today, Ben continues to lead community outreach and partnerships for the center, ensuring that those who need help can find a trusted, effective path to recovery.

name: Douglas Penny
role: VP of Business Development West Coast
bio:
With over 15 years of experience in the behavioral health care industry, Douglas Penny has built a career dedicated to expanding access to quality treatment and leading growth initiatives across the country. Based in Southern California, he has played a key role in developing and managing rehabilitation centers nationwide, combining strategic business development with a deep commitment to improving lives.
Douglas specializes in behavioral health program development, strategic partnerships, and team leadership, guiding organizations from concept to full-scale operations. With a proven ability to build strong referral networks and high-performing teams, he has helped treatment providers strengthen their impact and achieve sustainable growth.
Driven by a passion for behavioral health and a results-oriented approach, Douglas continues to champion innovation, collaboration, and excellence in every project he undertakes.

name: Mike Simmons
role: VP of Business Development East Coast
bio:
Mike Simmons serves as Vice President of Business Development for Quadrant Health Group, where he leads referral network expansion, admissions growth, and strategic partnerships.
Mike brings nearly a decade of experience in the behavioral health industry, with a strong track record in relationship-driven business development and patient acquisition. He began his career in alumni services, where he developed deep expertise in long-term engagement and referral pipeline development, which has translated into consistent admissions growth and strong industry relationships.
In his current role, Mike is responsible for expanding referral channels, strengthening provider relationships, and driving census growth across Quadrant’s East Coast locations. His ability to combine industry knowledge with a performance-driven approach to business development has been a key contributor to the platform’s growth and market positioning.
Mike plays a critical role in maintaining a sustainable and diversified admissions pipeline, supporting continued expansion and long-term value creation.

name: Richard Bradshaw
bio:
Richard Bradshaw is a seasoned professional in behavioral health and addiction treatment with over 15 years of experience in addiction and recovery, currently serving as Business Development Representative for Quadrant Health Group, a nationwide network of luxury addiction treatment centers focused on personalized, evidence-based care.
With extensive experience as Director of Admissions, Business Development, and over the last decade, he drives growth through strategic outreach, admissions processes, and operational excellence in the substance use disorder field.

name: Maggie Galleymore
bio:
Maggie Galleymore brings over a decade of experience in the substance use and mental health treatment field, with a strong passion for helping individuals and families navigate the path to healing. Her commitment to this work is deeply rooted in both professional expertise and personal understanding, allowing her to connect with clients and partners in a meaningful and compassionate way.
As a Business Development Representative for Quadrant Health Group, supporting both Dallas Detox Center and Fort Worth Wellness, Maggie is dedicated to building authentic relationships and helping individuals find the level of care that best supports their needs. She believes in meeting people where they are, advocating fiercely for those in need, and working collaboratively with trusted partners who share the same mission of recovery and healing.
Maggie is committed to ongoing growth in the behavioral health space and stays informed on evolving treatment approaches and recovery pathways to better serve the individuals and communities she works with.

name: EJ Larson
bio:
Elijah (EJ) serves as a Business Development Representative at Quadrant Health Group, bringing nearly a decade of experience in the substance abuse and mental health treatment field. His well-rounded background across multiple roles, including Behavioral Health Technician, Alumni Coordinator, and Outreach leadership, has given him a comprehensive understanding of the recovery journey and the importance of connecting individuals to the right level of care.
Elijah is deeply committed to building meaningful relationships within the community and expanding access to quality treatment. His approach is rooted in authenticity, compassion, and a strong belief that everyone deserves the opportunity to heal.
Originally from Las Vegas, Elijah studied at Mira Costa College and continues to grow professionally through hands-on experience and service. In his role at Quadrant Health Group, he is focused on fostering partnerships, supporting referral networks, and helping individuals and families take the first step toward lasting recovery.

name: Sage Steinberg
bio:
Sage's personal recovery journey ignited a passion for serving others and led her to a career in behavioral health. Over the past four years, she has focused on building strong relationships throughout the community while advocating for education, prevention, and treatment for substance use and mental health disorders.
As a Business Development Representative serving the east coast area, Sage is driven by the belief that meaningful collaboration creates better outcomes. She is dedicated to connecting providers, resources, and individuals in ways that make recovery more accessible, while fostering lasting partnerships that strengthen the continuum of care.

name: Nick Gore
bio: Nick Gore is a business development leader with nearly a decade of experience in behavioral healthcare. In long-term recovery since 2016, he is passionate about connecting individuals, families, employers, and healthcare partners with quality treatment resources. Throughout his career, Nick has built strong partnerships across healthcare systems, businesses, and communities, while advocating for improved access to mental health and substance use disorder treatment. His personal journey and professional experience drive his commitment to helping others find hope and recovery.

name: Lexie Zeller
bio: Lexie Zeller is a dedicated alumni relations professional with experience developing and growing alumni engagement programs that foster lifelong connections and meaningful involvement. With a strong background in relationship management, program development, and strategic planning, Lexie is passionate about creating alumni experiences that inspire connection, mentorship, and continued support. As National Alumni Director, she is leading the development of a nationwide alumni program focused on building an engaged network that empowers alumni to stay connected, give back, and make a lasting impact in their own recovery communities.

name: Robert Spady
bio:
As the Admissions Director at Quadrant Health Group, (change title) I understand that seeking help for addiction is a profoundly courageous act, often made during one of life's most challenging periods. With 10 years of dedicated professional experience in the field, my primary focus is to provide a clear, compassionate, and supportive pathway for individuals and families seeking treatment. I'm committed to guiding you through every step of the admissions process with empathy and expertise, ensuring you feel understood and confident in the care options available.
What truly drives my approach is a deep, personal understanding of the recovery journey. Having navigated my own battle with addiction for over a decade, and celebrating 12 years of sobriety through the principles of the 12 Steps AA program, I know firsthand the challenges and triumphs involved. This lived experience allows me to connect with clients and their loved ones on a uniquely empathetic level, offering not just guidance but also genuine hope for a new beginning.
Originally from Trenton, NJ, I am passionate about connecting people with the vital support they need to transform their lives. My goal is to alleviate the stress often associated with beginning treatment, providing comprehensive information and a steady hand as you take this crucial step towards healing and lasting recovery. I am here to help you or your loved one embark on a path to a healthier, more fulfilling future.

name: John Jurman
bio:
John Jurman is the Admissions Manager at Quadrant Health Group, where he oversees the admissions team and helps ensure a smooth, supportive process for individuals entering the company's care facilities. With over eight years of experience in healthcare admissions, John brings a strong commitment to organization, communication, and compassionate service, playing a key role in helping families navigate an often-stressful time with clarity and care.
Outside of work, John enjoys spending quality time with his family and cheering on Philadelphia's sports teams. Whether it's watching the Eagles on a Sunday or catching a Phillies game, he brings the same passion and dedication to his personal life that he brings to his role at Quadrant Health Group.

name: Cristina Turiello
bio:
Cristina Turiello is a kind, compassionate, and highly skilled behavioral health professional with over five years of experience at Quadrant Health Group. As the Director of Client Care, she leads a team dedicated to supporting individuals facing substance use and mental health challenges, ensuring they receive personalized, respectful, and effective care.
Cristina's journey in healthcare began as a patient advocate, where she championed the rights and well-being of individuals navigating complex systems. Her deep-rooted passion for helping others in all aspects of life continues to drive her work and leadership style today.
With a strong foundation in organization, attention to detail, and team leadership, Cristina brings structure and clarity to challenging environments while maintaining a warm, client-centered approach. She is known not only for her operational expertise but for her unwavering kindness, empathy, and ability to connect meaningfully with both clients and colleagues.
Cristina remains committed to making a difference—one compassionate interaction at a time.

name: Nicholas Incognito Jr.
bio: Nicholas Incognito Jr. is a seasoned professional with over a decade of experience in the behavioral healthcare sector, currently serving as the Director of QA at Quadrant Health Group, Inc. In this role, he is at the forefront of providing a compassionate and streamlined entry point for individuals seeking treatment for substance abuse and mental health. His leadership philosophy centers on a blend of strategic oversight and hands-on guidance, ensuring that every client's journey begins with professionalism and empathy. Throughout his career, Nicholas has developed a strong reputation for optimizing operational efficiency and enhancing client outcomes. He has a proven track record of significantly improving conversion rates and client engagement, which has been instrumental in the growth and success of the admissions department. By fostering a collaborative environment, he ensures seamless coordination between his team, other internal departments, and external referral partners, creating a clear and supportive path to care for all clients. Passionate about reducing the barriers that prevent people from accessing necessary treatment, Nicholas is deeply committed to supporting individuals and their families through one of the most critical decisions of their lives. When he's not busy guiding his team or refining internal systems, he enjoys spending time outdoors and exploring creative outlets, which help him stay grounded and energized for the important work he does.

name: Vinny Turiello
bio: Vinny Turiello is the Client Care Coordinator Supervisor at Quadrant Health Group, where he has been a key part of the team since 2022. With over eight years of prior experience in public safety, Vinny brings a calm, solutions-focused approach to helping individuals and families navigate the challenges of seeking treatment for substance use and mental health concerns. At Quadrant, Vinny leads a dedicated team focused on client engagement, admissions support, and care coordination. His background in public safety gives him a unique perspective on crisis response, communication, and building trust with clients during vulnerable moments. Vinny is committed to ensuring that every client feels heard, respected, and supported from their first point of contact through their transition into care. His mission is to make accessing treatment not only possible—but personal.
